lxvndr.bio: Halifax rapper LXVNDR is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose dark, mystical writing and imagery sit over underground rap production shaped by Nova Scotia's independent scene.

memblem.bio: Toronto artist and producer Memblem, also known as Michael Emblem, makes Canadian electronic and genre-blurring music and has earned support from producers including Timbaland and Kenny Beats.

mel pacifico.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter and vocal producer Mel Pacifico is a Canadian R&B artist whose silky vocals, layered harmonies and contemporary soul production position her among the country's emerging R&B voices.

mikey jose.bio: Vancouver singer-songwriter Mikey Jose is a Canadian R&B, gospel and pop artist whose independent music career runs alongside academic work in neuroscience.

nish.bio: Toronto Japanese-Canadian rapper Nish Raawks, born Derek Nishikawa, is a member of the Monolith collective whose work helped shape the city's independent hip-hop scene.

notifi.bio: Montréal-born, Toronto-raised rapper, singer and producer Notifi is a Canadian artist whose dark pop, R&B and hip-hop reflect the Scarborough and Jane-Finch communities where he grew up.

ovi wood.bio: Canadian singer and rapper OVI WOOD makes contemporary R&B and melodic hip-hop built around raw emotion, intimate writing and atmospheric production.
